bg.$description: Fill of the main action, e.g. Button primary.

bg-hover.$description: Fill of the main action under the pointer.

bg-pressed.$description: Fill of the main action while pressed.

fg.$description: Text on the main action's fill.

bg.$description: Fill of every other action, e.g. Button secondary.

bg-hover.$description: Fill of a secondary action under the pointer.

bg-pressed.$description: Fill of a secondary action while pressed.

bg.$description: Fill of an action that can't be used right now.

border.$description: Outline of a disabled secondary action.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring around an action.
